message: Hi, I'm a student with a hadoop certification background. My overall academic average is 78.6% in an IT/computer-science degree. I'm interested in IOT and developer. I want to become a Database Administrator. My family can afford at most about USD 2900 per year. I live in Delhi. I'd strongly prefer to stay near home, though I might consider elsewhere in India. Getting a good job after graduation matters more to me than anything else.

other_constraints: Interest in IOT and developer roles

explanation:
Ashford Institute of Applied Sciences
This program was recommended because it aligns well with your interests in data analytics and is located in Delhi. It has a very low annual tuition cost of $800, which fits comfortably within your budget while offering a strong placement rate of 78%. The curriculum's focus on Big Data Analytics is highly relevant to both Database Administrator roles and your interest in IoT. The main trade-off here is that the program does not offer any post-study work visa months.

Quilon Institute of Technology
This MTech Computer Science program was recommended because it builds upon your existing IT/CS background while offering a strong focus on software engineering, which suits your developer interests. At $1850 annually, the tuition remains within your budget and the median starting salary is high at $11,447. You meet the minimum grade requirement of 59% for admission. The primary trade-off to consider is that this program requires a CS background and does not offer post-study work visa months.

Longford Technical University
This MCA program was recommended due to its low annual tuition cost of $1350, making it the most budget-friendly option in Delhi. It also offers flexibility by not requiring a specific CS background for admission. While this course covers software engineering, which aligns with your interests, the main trade-off is that it has the lowest median starting salary ($6,635) and placement rate (64%) among the shortlisted options.
